note: Retired spec ids. Read-only history: each resolves to the case version and configuration version it actually ran, and records the version label its manifest carried (four labels said 0.2 over v0.1 instruments). Alias mode preserves legacy naming end to end (mission id, contract name, instrument tag, legacyId) so pre-migration cohorts stay uniform.

bm-1.legacyTitle: taskrun: a dependency-aware task runner (Java, Maven, command line)
bm-1.legacyComparisonEligibleNote: Version 0.x is a trial spec. benchmark-compare refuses any cohort below 1.0. Promotion to 1.0 happens once trial runs have set the fences from observed use, per the promotion rule in plans/benchmark-spec-bm1-design.md section S-6.
